title: Implement high resolution photo capture
description: Capture super high resolution photos in your app using AVFoundation. Learn when to use the three different options to capture images — RAW, exposure-bracketed, and fully processed. Walk through configuring photo capture for 24MP and 48MP images across the Main, Tele, and Ultra Wide cameras. And discover how deferred photo processing keeps your app responsive as more photos are taken.
